description: Practice platforms mapped to career domains with relevance scores.

programming.notes: Use LeetCode for algorithm/interview prep. Use HackerRank for language-specific. Use Codewars for practice. Use Exercism for mentored exercises.

web-frontend.notes: Use Frontend Mentor for real-world challenges. Use freeCodeCamp for structured learning. Use CodePen for experimentation.

web-backend.notes: Backend practice through coding challenges and API building.

sql-database.notes: Use SQLBolt for beginners. Use LeetCode SQL for interview prep. Use DataLemur for real-world data problems.

cybersecurity.notes: Use PortSwigger for web security. Use TryHackMe for beginners. Use HackTheBox for advanced. Use OverTheWire for Linux.

cloud-aws.notes: Use AWS Skill Builder for official labs. Use Well-Architected Labs for hands-on.

cloud-azure.notes: Use Microsoft Learn for official Azure labs.

cloud-gcp.notes: Use Google Cloud Skills Boost for official GCP labs.

devops-containers.notes: Use Play with Docker for Docker labs. Use KillerCoda for Kubernetes scenarios.

ai-ml.notes: Use Kaggle for competitions and notebooks. Use Coursera for structured courses.

data-science.notes: Use Kaggle for datasets and notebooks.

mobile.notes: Mobile practice through project building and exercises.

engineering-mechanical.notes: Use official CAD/CAE tutorials. Use NPTEL for theory.

engineering-civil.notes: Use NPTEL for theory. Use Autodesk tutorials for software.

engineering-electrical.notes: Use NPTEL for theory. Use circuit simulation tools for practice.

engineering-chemical.notes: Use NPTEL for chemical engineering theory.

networking.notes: Use Packet Tracer for network simulation.

linux.notes: Use OverTheWire Bandit for Linux basics. Use KillerCoda for scenarios.

git.notes: Use Learn Git Branching for interactive Git learning.

api-development.notes: API practice through coding challenges and Postman.

quality-testing.notes: Use HackerRank for test automation basics.

product-design.notes: Use Frontend Mentor for design implementation.

blockchain.notes: Use CryptoZombies for Solidity. Use Ethernaut for security.

rpa.notes: Use UiPath Academy for RPA training.
